notes: Ten of eleven submissions scored (a03 failed to build); Neon picked its numeric best, a11. The feet are pale with long toes rather than orange paws. Seven of ten rigs exceeded the 3x edge-stretch limit in run or jump; r07, r09 and r10 passed and Neon picked r10. Walk and run are short in-place gaits. The last turn took the estimate to US$17.66, past the US$17.46 stop.
The first GLB carries idle (2 s loop), walk (1 s loop), run (0.6 s loop) and jump (1.2 s). The second is the frozen mesh.
The cost values the logged Antigravity tokens at Google Standard Gemini API rates.
scope: One run on the frozen pirate-cat contract: 60,000-triangle cap, script-painted 1024 px texture, the four-clip rig contract. 10 scored meshes in 11 submissions and 3 passing native rigs in 10 submissions.
title: Gemini 4 Neon High: pirate cat with four clips
